purpose: Reader-robustness grid, part B of the L-shaped design (reader-robustness investigator): robustness reader seeds k2 and k3 on the registered repetitions R1 and R2. Same lean bank as NRM1_ROBUST_REPS, frozen outcome-blind at about 15:56Z on 2026-10-20, before any NRM1_MAIN output was read. Randomized members read their registered instance per cell (R1 0, R2 1), so k2/k3 cells differ from k0/k1 cells by the reader seed only; no Monte Carlo replicate members. Robustness cells never change a decision or a ranking (RULES.md sections 5.1 and 6).
